algotransparency.title: Jak funguje algoritmus
algotransparency.intro: V souladu s nařízením o digitálních službách (nařízení EU o digitálních službách) zde jsou hlavní parametry, které určují obsah, který na Nexusu vidíš, a jak je změnit.
algotransparency.foryou_p: Tento kanál řadí příspěvky podle několika faktorů. Zde je jejich přibližná relativní váha:
algotransparency.f_follow_desc: Příspěvky lidí, které sleduješ, jsou zvýrazněny.
algotransparency.f_engage_desc: Lajky a komentáře, které příspěvek získá, zvyšují jeho viditelnost.
algotransparency.f_interests_desc: Hashtagy a témata, se kterými interaguješ, řídí návrhy.
algotransparency.chrono_body: Máš právo na nepersonalizovaný kanál. Karta « Sledované » na Domů zobrazuje pouze příspěvky účtů, které sleduješ, v chronologickém pořadí, bez algoritmického řazení.
algotransparency.trends_body: Trendy odrážejí nejpoužívanější hashtagy za posledních 24 hodin, vážené počtem příspěvků a lajků. Obnovují se automaticky: žádná ruční redakční volba.
algotransparency.ads_body: Zobrazované reklamy jsou ve výchozím nastavení nepersonalizované: nejsou založeny na profilování tvého chování. Objeví se až po tvém souhlasu s cookies.
algotransparency.notuse_body: Žádné profilování na základě citlivých údajů (politické názory, náboženství, orientace, zdraví). Algoritmické návrhy můžeš vypnout v Nastavení → Soukromí.

faq.page_desc: Answers to the most common questions about Nexus Social: account, posting, privacy, security, moderation and technical aspects.
faq.lead: Here you'll find answers to the most common questions. If you can't find what you're looking for, write to us at
faq.c1_a1: Yes, creating an account and using the main features of Nexus Social are entirely free. Some advanced or monetization options may be paid, but the basic experience costs nothing.
faq.c1_q2: What's the minimum age to sign up?
faq.c1_a2: In accordance with French law, you must be at least 15 to create an account. Age is checked at sign-up and accounts that don't meet this rule may be suspended.
faq.c1_q3: How do I create an account?
faq.c1_a3: Go to the sign-up page and enter a username, a valid email address, your date of birth and a password. You'll receive a code by email to confirm your address, then your account will be activated.
faq.c1_q4: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq.c1_a4: On the login screen, use the « Forgot password? » link. You'll receive a code by email that lets you set a new password securely.
faq.c1_q5: How do I delete my account?
faq.c1_a5: You can delete your account at any time from the settings. Deletion erases or anonymizes your data, subject to legal retention obligations.
faq.c2_q1: What's the difference between a post, a Story and a Clip?
faq.c2_a1: A post stays on your profile over time. A Story is ephemeral and disappears after 24 hours. A Nexus Clip is a short, vertical video designed for discovery. Each format serves a different purpose.
faq.c2_q2: How long does a Story last?
faq.c2_a2: A Story stays visible for 24 hours, then disappears automatically. You can post as many as you like.
faq.c2_q3: What's the maximum video size for a Clip?
faq.c2_a3: Importing a Clip video is limited to 50 MB. For longer or heavier videos, dedicated video storage can be configured.
faq.c2_q4: Can I edit a post after publishing it?
faq.c2_a4: You can delete a post at any time. Editing options depend on the content type; when in doubt, it's sometimes easier to repost.
faq.c2_q5: How do I add music or stickers to a Story?
faq.c2_a5: In the Story editor, tap the Music tool to search for a clip, and the Stickers tool to add polls, questions, mentions, hashtags, GIFs, countdowns and much more. Every element can be moved and resized with your finger.
faq.c3_q1: Is my data sold to third parties?
faq.c3_a1: No. Nexus Social never sells your personal data. Your information is processed in accordance with the GDPR and sensitive data is encrypted.
faq.c3_q2: How do I make my account private?
faq.c3_a2: In the privacy settings, you can switch your account to private mode: only the followers you approve will be able to see your content.
faq.c3_q3: What is two-factor authentication and how do I enable it?
faq.c3_a3: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds a login code sent by email at each login, in addition to the password. You enable it in the settings, Security section. It's one of the most effective protections.
faq.c3_q4: How do I exercise my GDPR rights?
faq.c3_a4: You can access, correct, export or delete your data from the Privacy Center, or by writing to dpo@nexussocial.com. We respond within one month.
faq.c3_q5: How do I report or block someone?
faq.c3_a5: Use the reporting options available on profiles and content to alert our moderation team. Blocking immediately cuts off all contact with the person concerned.
faq.c4_a1: Prohibited content includes: illegal content, harassment and threats, spam and fake accounts, non-consensual sexual content, incitement to hatred or violence, impersonation and copyright infringement. See our community guidelines for details.
faq.c4_q2: What happens if I don't follow the rules?
faq.c4_a2: Depending on the severity, several measures may apply: a warning and content removal, a temporary limitation, suspension, or a permanent ban in the event of a serious or repeated breach.
faq.c4_q3: How do I appeal a moderation decision?
faq.c4_a3: If you believe a decision is unfair, you can appeal it by contacting our team. Every reported case is carefully reviewed.
faq.c5_q1: What devices does Nexus Social work on?
faq.c5_a1: Nexus Social is accessible from a web browser, on both phone and computer. The experience is optimized for mobile and loads quickly.
faq.c5_a2: Nexus Social requires an internet connection for most features. Push notifications can, however, alert you even when the app is closed, if you have enabled them.
faq.c5_q3: Why does some content take time to load?
faq.c5_a3: Loading time depends on your connection and the size of the media. We continuously optimize the platform to make it faster.

about.page_desc: Nexus Social is a modern social network to create, share and connect with confidence. Discover our mission, our values and our features.
about.intro: Nexus Social is a next-generation social network, designed to bring together what we love about sharing online — the spontaneity of Stories, the creativity of short videos, the richness of conversations — in a fast, elegant experience that respects your privacy.
about.mission_p: We believe a social network should bring people closer without exhausting them, value creation without giving in to the race for clicks, and protect its users rather than exploit their data. Our mission is simple: to offer a space where everyone can express themselves freely, discover content that inspires them and forge authentic connections, while always keeping control of their experience.
about.do_h2: What you can do on Nexus Social
about.do_intro: Nexus Social brings together several ways to share, each suited to a moment and a mood:
about.do_1: Posts to share photos, videos and ideas that stay on your profile.
about.do_2: Stories to tell your everyday life in an ephemeral format, with interactive stickers, music and effects.
about.do_3: Nexus Clips, our short vertical video format, made to be discovered and watched on a loop.
about.do_4: Messaging, with private conversations, groups, voice messages, notes and ephemeral Snaps.
about.do_5: A personalized feed that highlights what really interests you, thanks to a transparent ranking based on your interests.
about.v_trust_p: We put protecting our users at the heart of our priorities. Two-factor authentication, encryption of sensitive data, reporting and blocking tools, active moderation: everything is designed so you feel safe. We never sell your personal data.
about.v_privacy_p: You decide who sees your content, who can contact you and what information you share. In accordance with the GDPR, you can access, correct, export or delete your data at any time. Privacy isn't a hidden option: it's a right we make simple to exercise.
about.v_creation_p: Nexus Social is a space designed for creators, whether they're just starting out or already have a following. Powerful, smooth editing tools, a modern video format, fair discovery: we want to give everyone the means to make their voice heard.
about.v_community_p: A social network is only as good as its community. We apply clear rules against hatred, harassment and illegal content, and we encourage kindness. Discover our community guidelines.
about.age_p: In accordance with French law, signing up to Nexus Social is reserved for people aged at least 15. We take the protection of younger users seriously and verify age at sign-up.
about.tech_h2: Technology at the service of the experience
about.tech_p: Speed, smoothness and reliability guide our technical choices. Nexus Social is optimized for mobile, loads fast and works just as well on phone as on computer. We improve the platform continuously, listening to our community.
about.join_p: Whether you're looking to share your everyday life, grow an audience or simply stay in touch with your loved ones, Nexus Social welcomes you. See how it works or create your account now.

how.page_desc: Step-by-step guide to using Nexus Social: create an account, post, use Stories and Clips, chat and discover content.
how.intro: Nexus Social is easy to get started with. Here, step by step, is how to create your account, share your content and enjoy all the features.
how.s1_p: It all starts with sign-up. Enter a username, a valid email address, your date of birth (the minimum age is 15) and a strong password. For your security, your email address is confirmed with a code. Once your account is activated, you can personalize it: profile picture, bio and accent color.
how.s2_p: Your feed gathers posts from the accounts you follow as well as a selection of content you might like. The ranking highlights what interests you, based on your interactions. The more you like, comment on and watch content, the more relevant your feed becomes.
how.s3_p: Tap the create button to publish a photo, a video or text. Add a caption, hashtags to be found on a topic, and mention friends if you want. Your post appears on your profile and in your followers' feed. To go further, follow our guide Publish your first post.
how.s4_p: Stories are ephemeral content visible for 24 hours. From the composer, take a photo or a short video, then enhance it: text, drawing, filters, music and a wide range of interactive stickers (polls, questions, mentions, hashtags, GIFs, countdown, emoji slider, location, time and weather). Every element can be moved, resized and rotated with your finger, for a smooth composition. Our guide How to make the most of Stories tells you everything.
how.s5_p: Nexus Clips are short vertical videos, perfect for discovery. Film directly from the app or import a video, add a caption, and publish. The discovery algorithm highlights the clips that capture attention. To improve, check out Succeeding with Nexus Clips.
how.s6_p: Messaging lets you talk one-to-one or in a group. Send text, photos, voice messages, share notes visible to your close friends, or ephemeral Snaps. Everything is designed for a smooth and pleasant conversation, on mobile as well as on computer.
how.s7_p: A social network comes alive through interactions. Follow the accounts that inspire you, like the content you enjoy, comment, share. These gestures build your community and refine your feed. Reciprocity is the best way to grow.
how.s8_p: From the settings, you decide who sees your content (public or private account), who can message you, and you enable protections like two-factor authentication. Take a few minutes to configure these settings: our guide Privacy is there to help.
how.s9_p: Choose a unique password, enable two-factor authentication and beware of suspicious messages. If there's a problem, the reporting and blocking tools are there to protect you. See Security on Nexus for the right reflexes.
how.q_p: Our FAQ answers the most common questions, and our team remains reachable at support@nexussocial.com. Enjoy discovering Nexus Social!

guides.bien-utiliser-les-stories_html:
Stories are central to how we share today: they're quick to create, ephemeral and far more spontaneous than a classic post. On Nexus Social, a Story stays visible for 24 hours before disappearing automatically, which invites you to post without worrying about perfection. In this guide, we'll see how to make the most of this format, from shooting to the little details that make the difference.

What is a Story and what is it for?

A Story is a sequence of photos or short videos that your followers can watch one after another. Unlike a post that stays on your profile, a Story lives in the moment: it's perfect for showing behind the scenes of your day, reacting on the spot to an event, asking your community a question or simply sharing a mood. It's also a great way to stay present without overloading your followers' feed.

Creating your first Story

To create a Story, open the composer from the home screen or the Stories bar, then choose to take a photo, record a short video (up to fifteen seconds) or import a media from your gallery. Once your visual is ready, you enter the editor, where all the personalization happens.

  • Text: add a caption, a catchy title or a thought. Play with colors to stay readable on any background.
  • Drawing: underline a detail, circle an element or sign your Story freehand.
  • Filters: a few mood adjustments are enough to give your Stories a consistent visual identity.

Stickers to make your Stories interactive

This is where Stories come to life. Nexus Social offers a palette of stickers designed for engagement: mention a friend with a mention sticker, add a hashtag to join a wider conversation, pin a location, insert an animated GIF, show the time or the weather, launch a poll, ask a question, add an emoji slider to gauge a reaction, or set a countdown before an event. These elements turn a simple image into an invitation to react.

A tip: don't overload. Two or three well-placed stickers are better than a saturated image. Let your visual breathe, and place interactive elements where the eye naturally lands.

Music, the ingredient that changes everything

Adding a music clip immediately gives your Story an atmosphere. Choose a passage that matches the emotion you want to convey, and cue it at the right moment. A Story with the right music is watched to the end; without it, people often skip too fast.

Smooth gestures: move, resize, rotate

Every element you add is handled with your finger, naturally: slide with one finger to move, pinch with two fingers to resize and rotate at the same time. Take the time to compose your image as you would in a photo-editing app: a slightly tilted title, a sticker that follows a line in the image, and the result immediately looks more polished.

A few best practices

  • Tell a story: chain several segments to create a progression, rather than posting a single isolated image.
  • Think vertical: the full-screen vertical format is made for mobile, so frame accordingly.
  • Stay readable: white text on a light background disappears. Add a shadow or a background to the text if needed.
  • Post regularly: consistency builds habit and keeps your audience engaged better than an occasional big post.

Who sees your Stories?

You stay in control of your audience. Depending on your settings, a Story can be visible to all your followers or reserved for a smaller circle. Get into the habit of checking your visibility before posting more personal content. To go further, check out our dedicated privacy guide.

In summary

Stories are the ideal place to be authentic. A good visual, the right music, one or two interactive stickers, and above all consistency: that's the recipe. Don't wait for the perfect content, post what feels like you. It's this spontaneity that creates the bond with your community.
guides.securite-proteger-son-compte_html:
Your account is your online identity, your conversations, your memories and sometimes your income. Protecting it isn't optional: it's the first reflex to adopt. The good news is that a few simple steps are enough to make your Nexus Social account significantly safer. This guide covers the essential measures, from the most basic to the most advanced.

A strong password, the foundation of everything

Most compromised accounts are hacked because of a weak or reused password. A good password is long (at least twelve characters), unique to Nexus Social, and hard to guess. Avoid birth dates, first names and obvious sequences. An effective method is to string together several unrelated words, which gives a password that is both long and memorable.

Above all, never reuse the same password on several sites. If one of them is hacked, the others fall with it. A password manager lets you generate and remember a different one for each service.

Enable two-factor authentication (2FA)

Two-factor authentication adds a second barrier after the password. When it's enabled on Nexus Social, a login attempt triggers a one-time verification code sent by email. Even if someone knew your password, they couldn't log in without this code. You can enable this protection from the settings, in the Security section. It's one of the most effective measures, and it only takes a few seconds to set up.

Recognizing phishing

Phishing consists of tricking you into entering your credentials on a fake site or clicking a malicious link. A few signals should alert you:

  • An urgent message threatening you with suspension if you don't act immediately.
  • A link whose address doesn't match the official site.
  • A request for your password or verification code by message.
  • Spelling mistakes or a sloppy layout.

Remember a golden rule: Nexus Social will never ask for your password or your login code by private message. When in doubt, don't click, and always log in by typing the site address yourself.

What to do if my account is reset?

If you've forgotten your password, use the reset function from the login screen: you'll receive a code by email to set a new password securely. If you receive a reset email you didn't request, ignore it and change your password as a precaution.

Keeping an eye on your account day to day

  • Log out on shared devices: never stay logged in on a public computer.
  • Be careful with permissions: think before granting access to third-party services.
  • Keep your email up to date: keep a valid and secure email address, because it's the one that receives recovery codes.

Protecting your privacy too

Security doesn't stop at the password. Think about what you share: a photo can reveal your address, a live Story your location. Adjust who can see your posts, who can message you and what information appears on your profile. Our privacy guide details all these settings.

Reporting and blocking

If you're a victim of harassment, impersonation or suspicious behavior, use the reporting and blocking tools. Blocking someone cuts off all contact, and reporting content lets our moderation team act. You're never alone: protecting the community is part of our mission.

In summary

A unique and strong password, two-factor authentication enabled, vigilance against suspicious messages and suitable privacy settings: with these four reflexes, your Nexus Social account is already much better protected than average. Security is a habit, not a constraint.
guides.reussir-ses-nexus-clips_html:
Nexus Clips are the short vertical video format of Nexus Social, designed to be watched, liked and shared on a loop. It's a wonderful playground for creativity, but also a demanding format: on a scrolling feed, you have barely a second to convince. Here's how to give yourself the best chance.

Understanding the format

A Clip is watched full-screen, vertically, often with the sound on. It loops, which rewards videos that are well-paced and well-edited. The discovery algorithm highlights clips that hold attention: the more people watch your video to the end and interact, the more it's shown to new people. So your goal is twofold: hook fast, and make people want to stay.

The hook: the first three seconds

Everything is decided at the start. A good hook asks a question, shows a surprising result, makes a promise or creates tension to resolve. Avoid long introductions: get straight to the point. If your video is about how to nail a recipe, show the final dish in the very first frame, then explain. The viewer stays because they want to know how you got there.

Framing and light

Film vertically, stabilize your phone and take care of the light: a soft source facing you is better than a window behind you that plunges you into shadow. Clean framing and a sharp image immediately give an impression of quality, even with a simple smartphone.

Sound does half the work

A video with clear sound is far more pleasant than a beautiful image that's poorly recorded. Get closer to the microphone, avoid overly noisy environments, and think about music: a well-chosen soundtrack sets a mood and gives rhythm. Just make sure the music doesn't drown out your voice if you're speaking.

Editing: rhythm and clarity

  • Cut the fluff: every second must bring something. Remove the dead time.
  • Vary the shots: alternating angles keeps attention.
  • Add on-screen text: many people watch without sound at first. A subtitle or a keyword helps them understand at a glance.
  • End with an invitation: a question, a call to comment or follow encourages interaction.

Posting and captioning smartly

The caption isn't a detail. It gives context, adds a touch of humor or asks a question that invites comments. Stay concise and authentic. Preferably post when your audience is most active, and don't hesitate to test different times to see what works.

Analyzing and improving

Look at which clips work best and why. A high watch rate means your hook and pacing are good. Lots of shares indicate useful or entertaining content that people want to pass on. By observing these signals, you gradually refine your style and improve with every video.

Staying yourself

Technique helps, but authenticity always wins. The best creators aren't necessarily the best-equipped: they're the ones with a voice, a point of view, an energy. Post regularly, have fun, and let your personality show. That's what your community will come looking for.

In summary

A strong hook, careful framing, good sound, snappy editing and an engaging caption: those are the ingredients of a successful Nexus Clip. Add consistency and sincerity, and you'll see your audience grow clip after clip.
guides.publier-son-premier-post_html:
Getting started on a new social network can be intimidating. Where to begin? What to post? How to get noticed without overdoing it? This guide is here to support you in your very first steps on Nexus Social, from your profile to your first post.

Take care of your profile first

Your profile is your business card. Even before posting, take five minutes to fill it in properly. Choose a clear, recognizable profile picture, ideally your face or a logo if you represent a brand. Write a short bio that says who you are and what people will find with you. A complete profile inspires trust and makes people want to follow.

Understanding the different formats

Nexus Social offers several ways to share, and each has its use:

  • The classic post: a photo, a video or text that stays on your profile. Ideal for content you want to keep over time.
  • The Story: ephemeral 24-hour content, perfect for everyday life and spontaneity.
  • The Clip: a short vertical video, made for discovery and entertainment.
  • Messages: to talk in private, one-to-one or in a group.

To start, a simple post is perfect. You'll explore the other formats at your own pace.

Creating your first post

Open the post composer, add a photo or a video, then write text to go with it. No need to be a writer: just say what you feel like sharing. A sincere sentence is better than a long, impersonal text. You can add hashtags to be found on a topic, and mention friends with the at sign.

Choosing a good visual

On a social network, the image catches the eye first. Favor a bright, well-framed photo that tells something. You don't need professional gear: a recent smartphone and good natural light are more than enough. Avoid blurry or too-dark images that give an impression of carelessness.

Interacting, the key to growing

Posting is good; participating is better. Like the posts you enjoy, leave sincere comments, reply to the ones you receive. Social networks reward reciprocal engagement: the more present and kind you are, the more your community grows naturally. Don't wait for others to come to you, go and meet them.

Finding your rhythm

No need to post ten times a day. A regular, well-crafted post is better than a flood of uninteresting content. Find a sustainable rhythm that lets you keep the pleasure of creating without pressure. Consistency over time matters far more than intensity at the start.

Beginner mistakes to avoid

  • Leaving a profile empty or without a photo.
  • Copying others' style instead of finding your own.
  • Getting discouraged after a few posts with few views: visibility is built over time.
  • Neglecting the caption, which gives context and the urge to react.

In summary

A complete profile, a sincere first post, a careful visual and a real desire to connect: you have everything you need to get off to a good start. Don't seek perfection, seek authenticity. Welcome to Nexus Social.
guides.confidentialite-maitriser-son-audience_h:
Sharing is at the heart of a social network, but sharing doesn't mean showing everything to everyone. Nexus Social gives you precise tools to decide who sees what. Taking a few minutes to configure your privacy guarantees you a more serene experience.

Public or private account?

This is the first choice to make. A public account lets anyone see your posts and follow without approval: ideal if you're looking to reach a wide audience or grow a following. A private account, conversely, requires you to approve each new follower, and only your followers see your content. It's the recommended setting if you mainly share with close ones or want to keep a small circle.

The visibility of your Stories

Stories can have their own visibility level, independent of the rest. This way you can share a more personal moment with a small circle while keeping a public profile. Get into the habit of checking who your Story is aimed at before posting sensitive or location-based content.

Controlling messages

You're not obliged to accept messages from everyone. Depending on your settings, you can limit who's allowed to message you, filter requests from people you don't follow, or cut off a conversation at any time. If someone bothers you, blocking immediately ends all contact.

Thinking before you post

The best privacy setting remains your common sense. Before posting, ask yourself a few simple questions:

  • Does this photo reveal information I'd rather keep private, like my address or my workplace?
  • Am I comfortable if this content were seen by my family, my employer or a stranger?
  • Do I have the consent of the other people in the image?

A post can be deleted, but you never fully control what has already been seen or saved. Caution is your best ally.

Your personal data

Nexus Social is committed to protecting your data in accordance with the GDPR. You stay in control: you can view the information we hold, correct it, export it or request its deletion. Sensitive data is encrypted, and we never sell your personal information to third parties. To learn everything, see our Privacy Policy.

Handling unwanted people

Blocking, restricting, reporting: these tools exist to protect you, use them without hesitation. Blocking someone prevents them from seeing your content and contacting you. Reporting content or an account alerts our moderation team, which can take action. You never have to put up with abusive behavior.

In summary

Choose the account level suited to your use, adjust the visibility of your Stories, filter your messages and think about what you share. Privacy isn't a constraint: it's the freedom to share with confidence, on your own terms.
guides.regles-de-la-communaute_html:
A social network is only pleasant if everyone respects a few rules of communal life. On Nexus Social, we want a space where you can express yourself freely, create and connect without fear of hatred or harassment. This guide sums up the spirit of our rules and what's expected of every member.

Respect above all

Freedom of expression stops where disrespect toward others begins. You can disagree, debate, hold strong opinions, as long as it's done without insults, without contempt and without personal attacks. Treat others as you'd like to be treated: it's the simplest and most effective principle.

What is strictly prohibited

Some content has no place on Nexus Social, whatever the intention. By posting, you commit not to share:

  • Illegal content or content contrary to the law.
  • Harassment, threats or doxxing (disclosing someone's private information).
  • Spam, bots or fake accounts intended to deceive or manipulate.
  • Non-consensual sexual content, and absolutely any content involving minors, which is reported to the authorities.
  • Incitement to hatred or violence toward a person or a group.
  • Impersonation.
  • Content that infringes copyright.

This list isn't exhaustive: the spirit matters as much as the letter. When in doubt, refrain.

How moderation works

Moderation combines automated tools and human intervention. When content breaks the rules, several graduated measures can apply: a simple warning and content removal, a temporary limitation of certain features, an account suspension, and in serious cases a permanent ban. The most serious violations, such as credible threats, lead to immediate action.

Reporting content

The community is our best ally. If you see content or behavior that breaks the rules, report it: it alerts our team and allows quick action. Reporting is confidential. Blocking someone, on your side, immediately cuts off all contact with them.

Appealing a decision

Moderation isn't infallible. If you believe a decision is unfair, you can appeal it by contacting our team. We review reported cases carefully. Our goal isn't to punish, but to protect the community.

Building a positive community

Beyond the prohibitions, a good community is built on positive gestures: encouraging creators, leaving kind comments, sharing content that deserves to be seen, welcoming newcomers. Every member contributes to the overall mood. By giving your best, you encourage others to do the same.

In summary

Respect, rejection of hatred and harassment, legal and consensual content, and a spirit of kindness: that's the foundation of the Nexus Social community. Together, we make this space a good place to share.
guides.notifications-et-temps-decran_html:
Notifications are useful: they alert you to a new message, a follower or an interaction. But poorly set up, they become intrusive and fragment your attention. Here's how to configure Nexus Social to stay informed of the essentials without being overwhelmed.

Understanding the types of notifications

On Nexus Social, you receive several kinds of alerts: likes and comments on your posts, new followers, private messages, mentions in Stories or posts, and notifications from the app even when you're logged out (push notifications). Each one can be enabled or disabled independently.

Enabling push notifications

Push notifications let you be alerted even when the app is closed. They're handy for not missing an important message, but reserve them for what really matters. You can enable them from the notification bell or the settings, and your browser will ask for permission. You remain free to turn them off at any time.

Filtering the essentials

Ask yourself: what do I really want to know in real time? For many people, only private messages and direct interactions deserve an immediate alert. The rest can wait for your next visit. By disabling secondary notifications, you reduce the noise and focus on what has value for you.

Keeping a healthy use

A social network is meant to be a pleasure, not a chore. A few habits help keep a balanced use:

  • Set yourself moments: check the app at chosen times rather than in reaction to every notification.
  • Cut off at night: disabling alerts in the evening improves sleep and focus.
  • Take breaks: it's healthy to disconnect regularly.
  • Favor quality: a few enriching exchanges are better than endless scrolling.

Notifications and privacy

Your notification preferences are personal and changeable at any time. They don't affect what others see: disabling an alert signals nothing to anyone. You keep control of your experience, without pressure.

In summary

Enable the notifications that serve you, turn off the ones that distract you, and set yourself dedicated moments. Well configured, Nexus Social adapts to your life, not the other way around. Control of your attention belongs to you.
guides.messagerie-et-instantanes_html:
Beyond the public feed, Nexus Social is also a space for private conversation. Messaging lets you talk one-to-one or in a group, share media, send voice messages and stay close to your friends. This guide covers everything it offers.

Starting a conversation

To write to someone, open messaging and search for the person by their username, or start the chat from their profile. You can send text, photos, videos, links and much more. Recent conversations appear at the top of your list, the most active first.

Groups

Group chats bring several people together around a topic, a project or simply a circle of friends. You can name the group, add participants and chat as in a classic conversation. Groups are perfect for organizing an event or keeping in touch with a set of close ones.

Voice messages

Sometimes a voice message says things better than text. Messaging lets you record your voice and send it in a few seconds. It's handy when you're on the move, or to convey an emotion that text wouldn't capture. The recipient can listen, pause and move through the recording as they like.

Notes

Notes are short statuses you share with your mutual follows, visible at the top of messaging. It's a light and fun way to let people know your current mood or drop a little line, without posting a full Story. A note disappears on its own after a while, keeping your messaging fresh and lively.

Snaps

Snaps are ephemeral photos you send directly into a conversation, like a visual wink. They vanish after being viewed, which invites spontaneity. It's the ideal format for sharing a fleeting moment with a specific person, without leaving it lying around.

Reactions and reading comfort

You can react quickly to a message with a simple gesture, which avoids replying with a word when an emoji is enough. Conversations are designed to be smooth on mobile, with comfortable typing and a clear display, even during busy exchanges.

Communicating safely

Messaging remains a private space, but a few reflexes are essential. Never share your passwords or login codes, even with a close friend. Beware of unexpected links. And if a conversation becomes unpleasant, you can leave it, block the person or report them. Your settings also determine who's allowed to message you.

In summary

Conversations, groups, voice messages, notes and Snaps: Nexus Social messaging covers every use, from the most relaxed to the most spontaneous. Explore it, find the formats that suit you, and always keep the right safety reflexes in mind.
